case_summary: A threat actor exploited a known vulnerability (CVE-2023-22527) in an unpatched Confluence server to gain initial access, then deployed ELPACO-team ransomware after establishing persistence and privilege escalation.

tools_used.purpose: Monitoring system events for suspicious activities

source_title: Another Confluence Bites the Dust: Falling to ELPACO-team Ransomware - The DFIR Report
